findings.summary: The no-acknowledgement case does not prove that a live owner acquired the transaction before cleanup.
findings.diagnosis: With ack=False, the seam suppresses the only signal that gated() was entered. The test cannot distinguish a live owner blocked inside the transaction from one that never reached the gate or returned immediately; all produce the same timeout and terminal assertions.
findings.evidence: install_owner_gate sets acquired only when ack is true and exposes no unconditional entry event. An immediate no-op owner would satisfy the test.
findings.correction: Expose an unconditional gate-entry event, await it with the stable timeout, assert transaction_owner is not None, then wait for the deliberately suppressed acknowledgement and retain cleanup/terminal assertions.
